title: Chapter 455
content:
Chapter 455

With the participation of these empires, the remaining rebellions are naturally nothing, and they cannot cause any major chaos.

Therefore, with this advantage, Zhou Guo quickly calmed down the war in this storm, quickly restored peace and stability in the central region, and began to recuperate.

Up to now, Zhou Guo and those vassal countries under his command, there are actually 17 immortal powerhouses combined, which is extremely eye-catching among all the empires alone.

If it weren't for the appearance of a more perverted freak like Yuguo, maybe Zhou Guo would have been able to gradually unify the entire world with his method of dividing the seal.

With this kind of strength, it is already equivalent to the strength of most of the imperial kingdom on the bright side. Without knowing the real terrifying strength of Zhong Yu, Zhou Guo naturally will not choose to surrender easily, but intends to resist.

This resistance was not of much use, although the angels sent by the forward were frustrated and the war was stalemate. But Zhong Yu couldn't bear it anymore, and when he really took action, Zhou Guo realized how terrifying their enemy was.

It was almost a one-sided battle. After Zhong Yu made his move, he didn't need the help of the angels under him at all, and Zhong Yu alone pressed the Chinese angels to fight.

And not long after the start of the war, Zhong Yu beheaded Zhou's Taizu, and by the way, killed the other three immortals of Zhou's on the spot, and got rid of the core characters of Zhou's alliance in one fell swoop.

These angels were originally centered on the angels of the Zhou Kingdom, and they were united with each other, and they used it as a hub to reluctantly form an alliance to jointly fight against the Yuguo.

Now the leaders of the Zhou Kingdom have all been killed, and the remaining people are not compatible with each other, and there were contradictions before, so naturally it is impossible to unite again.

Especially when they discovered that the enemy on the opposite side was far beyond their imagination, and their strength was too strong to stop them.

In an instant, more than half of the remnants chose to surrender, and the rest wanted to flee.

Zhong Yu did not punish those who chose to surrender, but left some people to watch over them, and strictly ordered the captives who surrendered not to act rashly.

Then Zhong Yu chased after the fleeing angels in person.

Since he dared to oppose Yuguo, he had to be prepared to accept defeat after defeat. If he wanted to escape, how could it be so easy.

What's more, after these angels escaped, it would be very difficult to hunt them down and bring them to justice.

Although Zhong Yu is powerful and can easily deal with dozens of powerhouses of the same rank, this does not mean that he can easily find an immortal who insists on hiding his whereabouts.

So take advantage of now to hunt down more enemies, even if you can't make a forced landing, you can't let the enemies go back, so that they will cause trouble for Zhong Yu in secret in the future.

After a period of time, the seven or eight people who escaped were killed by Zhong Yu and three or four were beheaded.

In this regard, the Zhou Empire, which had dominated Zhongzhou for thousands of years, was destroyed, Yuguo rose completely, and no one in the world could stop it.

Half a year later, after stabilizing all areas of the Zhou Empire and unifying the power of the entire Imperial Kingdom, Zhong Yu continued his journey.

In March, the Sui Empire surrendered.

Since then, the entire human race in the world of Liaozhai, only the Qin Empire is left in the Yuguo.

The reason why the Qin Empire was kept by Zhong Yu to the end was not only because it was the farthest from the center of Yuguo, but also because the Qin Empire had the strongest strength among the five great empires in the world, and its national system also had the greatest war potential. It can be easily destroyed as easily as the other four empires.

After years of fighting each other, the Qin Empire successfully annexed the eight major empires in the northwest and became the only powerful country among the five major empires that truly unified a large area.

And because of the annexation of a large area, the Qin Empire has gathered 23 angels, and although these angels have different minds, because of the Qin Empire's farming and warfare system, they can exert most of their strength, and their cohesion is extremely strong.

In addition, the Qin Empire has an elite army with a number of 300 million, which can mobilize a powerful military force of more than 1 billion with a single order, which is simply not comparable to other empires.

Therefore, the Qin Empire was left to the final solution, and when Zhong Yu merged with the other three major empires and gathered the power of all ethnic groups in the world to deal with the mere Qin State, the odds of winning were naturally greatly guaranteed.

Now the power of the Imperial Kingdom is the proof.

The number of Tianxian reached 63, the scale of the army reached 500 million, and a 3,000-person sixth- and seventh-order army was the capital used by Zhong Yu to conquer the Qin Empire.

War is imminent.

Half a year later, the war between the Qin Empire and the Yuguo was completely defeated. A total of 15 gods from the Qin state died in the battle. Among them, none of the royal gods survived, and they all chose to fight the enemy on the battlefield to die.

However, although the Qin Empire was wiped out, seven heavenly immortals were also killed on Zhong Yu's side, and the loss was not small.

Fortunately, after the Qin Empire was annihilated, those angels who surrendered in Qin joined the camp of Yu country, and then gathered some wandering angels in the wild, the number of angels in Yu country not only did not decrease, but increased somewhat, reaching 76 people.

After the unification of the human race, in order to cope with the situation where the human race is now weak, the demon race is gradually rising. Zhong Yu, as the co-owner of the human race in the world of Liaozhai, launched the war between the human race and the demon race.

This war is a full 30 years.

Although the power of the human race has been unified, the internal friction has caused great damage after all.

However, the demon clan hid in the dark to recuperate for a long time, and their strength was greatly enhanced. After Zhong Yu unified the empire, the power even surpassed the human race.

Therefore, although Zhong Yu started a war, and his own strength was strong within the same rank, no one could stop him, but he still could not eliminate the demon clan at once, but fell into a long-term war consumption.

However, the war ended in the victory of the human race. The demon race was completely damaged in this battle. All the demons above the fifth rank were slaughtered, and the remaining little demons could no longer become a climate.

Since then, with the whole world of Liaozhai, the humanism has completely surpassed the demonic Taoism, coupled with the disappearance of the heavenly Taoism, Zhong Yu has been fed back by the humanistic Taoism. Among the heavens and the world, even in those top worlds, it can be called a strong man.

Countless years later, as more and more worlds were fought, and countless worlds were brought under control, Zhong Yu's cultivation was greatly improved, and he eventually became the pinnacle of the heavens and the world.

In the end, Zhong Yu gathered the power of all the worlds in the heavens and successfully defeated the Dao, taking its place and becoming the master of the entire universe.

(End of the book!)
